method.workload: 49 inventory stones, frozen nine-placed-stone state, effective depth 3, 512 iterations, seed 0.
method.timing: Sequential isolated processes; search.search only, setup/teardown excluded; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
method.cuda: Evaluation/native/placement 128/32/32, 4 result workers, progressive widening; unchanged YAML from step 2.
method.cpu: Current CPU profile, 12 workers, different root retention/evaluation allocation; not a hardware-only or decision-quality comparison.
method.comparisons: legacy-control and native-stop share the same native binary and app source; only legacy full-horizon replay is overridden. native-repeat verifies final source after dataclass.replace compatibility completion.
method.baselines: Step-2 baseline and CPU-before are prior measured runs included verbatim from the linked reports.
method.limitations: One scene and seed, with two optimized CUDA timings. Step-3 gain is small and workload-dependent. Ordered tree digests exclude diagnostics, observations and trajectories; separate tests cover those interfaces. Native FP64 arithmetic is tested to tolerance, not bit-identical at every possible threshold boundary.
method.timers: CUDA stage times include native host and result handling, not pure kernel time. Computed timesteps exclude finished-job no-ops; the host still enqueues the full step limit.

validation.test_coverage: Native replay timestep/pose/metric parity; strict time bounds; near-limit unsettled and simultaneous motion-limit priority; rotated anisotropic inertia; invalid/continued rules; sparse/compact samples; older-core fallback; scene ownership; lazy optional field access; policies/artifacts/pickle/deepcopy/dataclasses.replace/concurrent readers; search, both platforms and visualization.
